surface: The old ceiba leans wrong, like it's listening.
truth: Someone hid a locket in its hollow trunk the night they died.
share_text: There's a locket hidden inside the ceiba's hollow trunk.

surface: Grave 37 has no photo, no name, fresh marigolds anyway.
truth: It belongs to Solorio — nobody says his name, so he fades.
share_text: Grave 37 is Solorio's. Say his name and he remembers himself.

surface: The fountain's water ripples against the wind.
truth: It shows the living world at midnight — families lighting candles.
share_text: The fountain shows the living at midnight. That's why Inés never leaves.

surface: Doña Sefa's agua fresca tastes like a warm afternoon.
truth: It's brewed with real marigold — the one thing the dead can still taste.
share_text: Sefa brews real marigold into the aguas. That's why they taste of home.

surface: Abuela Inés watches the ceiba more than the fountain.
truth: She saw someone bury a box there the night the bridge appeared.
share_text: Inés saw someone bury something under the ceiba long ago.

surface: The marigold bridge only appears once a year.
truth: It stays for whoever is still remembered — it never truly leaves.
share_text: The bridge never leaves. It just stops waiting for the forgotten.

surface: One frame on the great ofrenda stands empty.
truth: Genero's photo was taken down — the frame was left behind, bare.
share_text: Someone took Genero's photo off the ofrenda tonight.

surface: Doña Sefa keeps glancing at the empty frame.
truth: Sefa took the photo down herself before sundown — nobody asked her to.
share_text: They say Doña Sefa took Genero's photo down herself, before the candles were lit.

surface: Genero? The older spirits go quiet at the name.
truth: Genero sold the village's winter corn for coin before he died — Sefa never forgave him. Some say she still lights his candle in private.
share_text: Genero sold the winter corn for coin, and Sefa never forgave him — but they whisper she still lights his candle.
verdict_pass: The village has heard the whole story — Genero's photo goes back on the ofrenda. Forgiveness is also an offering.
verdict_fail: The frame stays empty tonight. Some silences are heavier than marigolds.

surface: Genero's frame stands empty on the great ofrenda.
truth: Sefa didn't just take the photo down — she hid it, and some say she sold the frame itself at the night market.
share_text: Sefa didn't just remove Genero's photo — she stole it away, maybe sold the frame at the night market

surface: One candle on the great ofrenda stays unlit.
truth: It's Genero's candle — Padre Aurelio can't bring himself to light it while the photo is missing.
share_text: Aurelio leaves Genero's candle unlit while his frame stays bare.

surface: A lullaby drifts from the bridge after midnight.
truth: The bridge hums the names of the remembered — Violeta fell asleep listening once.
share_text: The bridge sings to whoever is still remembered. Violeta heard her own name once.

surface: Fresh candles keep appearing on a nameless grave.
truth: La Viuda Carmen lights them for Solorio — she's watched him fade for years and never stopped.
share_text: Someone still lights candles for the fading spirit at grave 37 — the widow Carmen.
